mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6%, signaling a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) signals broadening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between HOUST, RSAFS, and SPX returns remains below 0.2 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (industrial production) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase in the same month, signaling inflation concerns, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase in the same month
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between FEDFUNDS, CPIAUCSL, and negative SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, PAYEMS (non-farm payroll employment) growth is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as job growth indicates economic health.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession regime, a GDPC1 quarterly growth rate exceeding 1.5% signals robust recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered post-recession instances despite strong GDP growth.
